name: browser-use
headline: Jobbernaut Tailor - AI-Powered Career Intelligence
short_description: Enterprise-grade Career Intelligence Platform with multi-layer validation, and fact verification. Processes 200+ documents with 100% accuracy and near zero hallucinations. ⚠ Main branch outdated - see development branches for v4.2+ features.
author: Jobbernaut

sections.overview:
Jobbernaut Tailor is an AI-powered resume and cover letter automation platform designed for job seekers processing multiple applications at scale. The system generates tailored, ATS-optimized documents through a 12-stage pipeline that includes job resonance analysis, company research, and storytelling arc development. Multi-stage validation ensures accuracy: input validation, Pydantic schema enforcement, fact verification for hallucination detection, quality thresholds, and LaTeX PDF compilation. The platform processes 10 concurrent jobs in approximately 90 seconds with a >99.5% success rate after automatic retry mechanisms. New humanization features bypass AI detection with >95% success while maintaining professional tone.
Job seekers processing 10+ applications simultaneously with tailored resumes and cover letters
Career services platforms automating bulk resume generation while maintaining quality standards
Recruitment automation systems requiring ATS-optimized, verified candidate documents
Resume optimization workflows that need hallucination detection and fact verification

sections.usage:
```
Analyze [COMPANY] in the [INDUSTRY] sector using Jobbernaut Tailor. Identify key job openings, required skills, and company culture insights. Provide a tailored resume optimization strategy based on [DATA] from their recent job postings and employee reviews.
```
